name: tet methylcytosine dioxygenase 3
pathways: positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II

function.text: TET3 encodes methylcytosine dioxygenase TET3. Annotated molecular activities include DNA 5-methylcytosine dioxygenase activity and methyl-CpG binding. It participates in positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and protein O-linked glycosylation.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to Beck-Fahrner syndrome (autosomal dominant); Beck-Fahrner syndrome (autosomal recessive).

somatic.text: This gene is included in cancer-panel definitions, but a disease-specific somatic association has not been assigned from the alteration-context sources reviewed for this draft.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal dominant; definitive GenCC assertion from ClinGen. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
Autosomal recessive; strong GenCC assertion from Labcorp Genetics (formerly Invitae). Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
